title: Review of c02's FCH chemoton (SIBE): replicated on seed 31; starved vesicles die by t~1200; a gate-free 100x-slower catalyst keeps the vesicles but loses the catalyst layer to free bath spots
summary: Fresh labkit runs on seed 31 (192^2, T=600). From the noisy bath, bilayer vesicles and multilamellar vesicles form by t~80-150; three carry catalyst beaded along their bilayers and persist to t=600 (K rim/core 2.56, rim/outside 7.26, membrane-like; total amphiphile 4896). Precursor cut at t=300 (world_starve.py, same seed): vesicles shrink to rings by t~400, to 2-3-micelle clusters by t~550, and total amphiphile falls 4756 -> 351 (t=600) -> 1.8 (t=1200, starve_long). Gate off (gate=0, same D): catalyst gone, amphiphile 35 at t=600, as in the claim. Gate off with catalyst D lowered 100x (DK=0.0005): vesicles survive (amphiphile 4768), but the catalyst escapes into free Gray-Scott spots all over the bath and the K layer is lost (rim/core 1.41, rim/outside 1.23, not membrane-like). So the min-face bilayer gate is what makes the catalyst a layer of the vesicle; a uniformly slower catalyst does not.

observations.S: rerun/sheet.png t=0: noisy bath over the whole domain; droplets by t=24, bilayers by t=51
observations.I: rerun/sheet.png t=132-600: three catalyst-bearing vesicles of fixed size and place, plus one catalyst-free ring
observations.B: rerun/radial.png: catalyst K rim/core 2.56, rim/outside 7.26 (15/27 individuals membrane-like); lost in nogate_lowD/radial.png (1.41, 1.23)
observations.E: totals.txt: fed 4896 at t=600; feed cut at t=300 on the same seed -> 351 at t=600 and 1.8 at t=1200 (starve/sheet.png: vesicles -> rings -> micelle clusters)

controls_run.E: starve/ and starve_long/ (seed 31, precursor feed off at t=300, branched from the same seed as rerun/)
controls_run.B: nogate/ (gate off: K and bilayers gone) and nogate_lowD/ (gate off, DK 100x lower: vesicles persist, K leaves the bilayers for free bath spots)

verdicts.limitation: E is largely by construction (amphiphile is made only by K from P and decays at kap), and dependence is shown for the population, not per individual: on seed 31 a catalyst-free ring persists in the fed run, living on amphiphile shared through the bath. Survival of the vesicles is not beyond diffusion (the 100x-slower gate-free twin keeps them), only the catalyst layer is. No division; one fresh seed; no resolution test.
